{{Top|leg}}
'''Nana Bagwa's liver and onions''' was a dish served at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] for 7.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. It consisted of the [[Liver/Legends|liver]] of a [[Mutant|mutated]] [[Rat/Legends|rat]] and [[Onion/Legends|onions]] and was originally made by and named after [[Nana Bagwa]], the grandmother of [[Hermione Bagwa/Legends|Hermione Bagwa]], one of the waitresses the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] chef [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] employed at his diner. Ironically, Hermione disliked the dish as a child, but she did enjoy Dex's version of the recipe.
